title: Welcome to the School of Computing
text:
Faculty Overview
        Welcome to the School of Computing
        
        The School of Computing at Maduka University is a dynamic and forward-thinking faculty dedicated to producing world-class computing professionals. Established as one of the cornerstone schools of Maduka University, we offer a vibrant academic environment where technology, creativity, and critical thinking converge.
        Our programmes are fully accredited by the National Universities Commission (NUC) and are designed to meet the demands of Nigeria's rapidly evolving digital economy. We are committed to equipping every student with the technical skills, ethical grounding, and professional mindset needed to excel in the global technology industry.
        3Programmes
          10+Faculty
          200+Students
      HOD
          "The School of Computing is not just an academic institution — it is a launchpad for the next generation of Nigerian tech leaders. We are building minds that will shape Africa's digital future."
          Dr. Onuoha M Thomas
          Head of Department — School of Computing

title: Our Core Values
text:
What We Stand For
    Our Core Values
    
    These values define who we are, how we operate, and what we expect from every student, lecturer, and staff member of the School of Computing.
    01 —Academic ExcellenceWe pursue and uphold the highest standards of academic rigour, intellectual curiosity, and scholarly achievement in everything we do.
      02 —IntegrityWe operate with honesty, transparency, and strong ethical principles — in our research, our relationships, and our professional practice.
      03 —InnovationWe encourage creative thinking and problem-solving, pushing boundaries to develop solutions that address real challenges facing Nigeria and the world.
      04 —CommunityWe foster a strong sense of belonging, mutual support, and collaboration — because the best technology is built by people who work well together.
      05 —Industry RelevanceOur curriculum is continuously aligned with global and Nigerian industry standards so every graduate is job-ready from day one.
      06 —ServiceWe are committed to using technology as a force for good — serving our communities, our nation, and the African continent with purpose.

title: Our Vision
text:
Looking Ahead
    Our Vision
    
    "To be the foremost School of Computing in Nigeria, recognised for producing world-class technology professionals, groundbreaking research, and meaningful contributions to Africa's digital transformation."
      Our vision is not just aspirational — it is a commitment we make to every student who walks through our doors. We are building the infrastructure, the faculty, the partnerships, and the culture required to make Maduka School of Computing a name synonymous with computing excellence across Africa.
      We envision a school where every graduate is a global competitor, where research moves from classroom to industry, and where the name "Maduka University's School of Computing" opens doors in Lagos, London, and Silicon Valley alike.
  Where We Are Going
      Nigeria's next generation of tech leaders starts here.
      From Enugu to the world — the School of Computing is building something that will outlast all of us.

title: Our Mission
text:
Our Purpose
    Our Mission
    
    "To provide a rigorous, innovative, and inclusive computing education that empowers students with the technical skills, ethical values, and professional mindset to lead Nigeria's digital future."
      Our mission guides every decision we make — from how we design our curriculum to how we support students inside and outside the classroom. We are not just here to teach programming and theory. We are here to transform lives, build careers, and produce graduates who make a real difference.
  How We Deliver It
    Mission in Action
    
    Industry-Aligned CurriculumCourses designed with input from Nigerian and global tech employers to ensure real-world relevance.
      Hands-On LearningState-of-the-art computer labs, cybersecurity servers, and practical projects that build real skills.
      Research & InnovationActive research culture with projects in AI, cybersecurity, and software engineering.
      Student CommunityThriving clubs, societies, and student-led initiatives that build professional networks early.
      Qualified FacultyExperienced lecturers with academic credentials and industry backgrounds who invest in every student.

title: Rules & Regulations
text:
Conduct & Compliance
    Rules & Regulations
    
    Every student, staff member, and visitor of the School of Computing is expected to abide by these rules at all times. Violations may result in disciplinary action.
    Rule 01Students must maintain a minimum attendance of 75% in all courses to qualify for end-of-semester examinations.
      Rule 02All forms of academic dishonesty — including plagiarism, cheating, and impersonation — are strictly prohibited and will result in immediate disciplinary action.
      Rule 03Students must adhere to the approved faculty dress code at all times within school premises. See the Dress Code section for full details.
      Rule 04All laboratory equipment must be handled with care. Any damage caused by negligence will be the responsibility of the student involved.
      Rule 05Mobile phones must be silenced during lectures. Unauthorized use of devices during examinations is a serious offence.
      Rule 06Students are expected to treat all members of the faculty — lecturers, staff, and fellow students — with respect and courtesy at all times.
      Rule 07Departmental dues must be paid in full before students can access certain faculty resourc

title: Admission Requirements
text:
Entry Requirements
    Admission Requirements
    
    Admission into any of the three programmes is processed through the JAMB UTME or Direct Entry routes. Requirements below are as stipulated by NUC and Maduka University's admissions policy.
    All Programmes
      Computer Science
      Software Engineering
      Cybersecurity
    UTME JAMB Entry Requirements (All Programmes)
        →Candidates must sit for the JAMB UTME and choose Maduka University as first or second choice institution.
          →Required JAMB subjects: Mathematics, English Language, and any two of Physics, Chemistry, Biology, or Economics (varies by programme).
          →Minimum JAMB cut-off mark as stipulated by JAMB and Maduka University for the relevant academic session.
          →Five (5) O'Level credit passes at WAEC/NECO in not more than two sittings, including Mathematics and English.
      DIRECT ENTRY Direct Entry Requirements (All Programmes)
        →A'Level results in relevant subjects from NABTEB, Cambridge A-Level, or similar for entry into 200 Level.
          →OND/HND holders in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related fields may also qualify subject to assessment.
          →A

title: SOC Is a Family
text:
Who We Are
    SOC Is a Family
    
    The School of Computing is more than a faculty — it is a community of thinkers, builders, and problem-solvers who share a common belief: that technology, when built with purpose, can change lives. From the first day of 100 Level to graduation day and beyond, every student becomes part of something bigger than their individual degree.
        We are a small school with a big heart. Our size is our strength — it means every lecturer knows your name, every student has a voice, and every challenge you face is met by people who genuinely care about your success. The SOC community supports you inside the classroom, outside it, and long after you leave.
        Whether you are here to build the next great Nigerian startup, secure the country's digital infrastructure, or push the boundaries of computing research — you belong here. And we are glad you are here.
